produces: src/·test/ 코드, build proposal, what-did-not-work log, closed_checks entries, coding record

recomputation.checked_by: TBD (follow-up — issue-521 out-of-scope note: per-role recomputation enforcement is a follow-up once evidence from real usage shows which roles need it)
recomputation.rule: verdict is recomputed by re-parsing commit_sha's message header against the Conventional Commits grammar, never a standalone asserted field.

reference_resolution.rule: commit_sha must resolve to an actual commit on the branch — no orphan references (issue-515 invariant 2).

use_when.board_condition: a commit lands on the branch AND no implementation record exists yet for that commit sha

use_when: 스펙/제안이 승인됐고 신규 구현이 필요할 때. 검증은 안 한다 — 자기 주장 확인(빌드·자기 테스트 1회)까지만
